CCTL* and counter-free CECTL* are equivalent formalisms, i.e., they specify the same class of tree languages. 4 Expressiveness equivalence of MCL and CECTL* It is known [3] that each CECTL* state formula has an equivalent MCL sentence. In this section, we show that the two logics CCDL and MCL are in fact expressively equivalent. We provide a proof of this result which relies on an adaptation of the compositional argument given in [38] for showing that each MPL sentence has an equivalent CCTL* state formula.
